decision.observation: Still 0 mph after a full 1.0s plain-W hold, all dots dark, no red X. A pine trunk stands immediately beyond the nose (the headlight beam stops at it). The posted lane with puddles lies to the right.
decision.hypothesis: Two 0-mph frames after a full throttle hold with a trunk right at the nose means a nose pin. Backing out with left steer should clear the trunk and swing the nose toward the lane on the right.
decision.memory: Plain W failing from 0 mph in this pine area = pin; the S+A (reverse-left) recovery has worked twice here to free and re-aim.
